newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Real Estate Bank to issue bonds.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Real Estate Bank to issue bonds.

text.p: Kuwait Real Estate Bank will issue five-year bearer bonds worth 20 million dinars ($66 million) with a fixed annual interest of 7-3/4 percent, a banker said on Monday.
"Kuwait Real Estate Bank will issue new bonds worth 20 million dinars at 7-3/4 percent, maturing May 25, 2002," said a National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) official.
NBK is the manager and underwriter of the issue which will be open to individuals and institutions in Kuwait and abroad.
"An application has been made to list the bond on the Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE)," said the banker. "It is listed with Euroclear and Cedel."
A statement by Real Estate Bank said: "The purpose of the issue is to boost the resources of the bank and finance mid-term and long-term lending operations."
May 25 is the issue date for the 5,000-dinar bonds which will pay the annual interest on May 25 starting 1998.
The Real Estate Bank has two outstanding bond issues with a total value of 35 million dinars. One matures later this month and the second matures December 25, 1998.
